{{Quote|I think I found just what we need&hellip; Imperial long-range rocket rifle. Nearly obsolete&mdash;but still able to get the job done.|Ten Numb|<ref name="X-wing" />}}
The '''Imperial long-range rocket rifle''' was a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The rocket rifle was outdated by the [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], but was still utilized by an Imperial [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] during an [[Raid at Coronet|attack]] on [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. After the storm [[Commando/Legends|commando]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in battle, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] used the commando's rocket rifle to destroy an Imperial [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]].

==Description==
A [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] designed to destroy a target at a distance, the Imperial long-range rocket rifle was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Despite being nearly obsolete by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor's]] aftermath, the rocket rifle was still highly effective on the battlefield and was powerful enough to take down an Imperial [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] in one shot. The rocket rifle was a long, [[black]] tube with a pair of barrels, one at the missile launcher's front and another at its rear. The rocket rifle also had a pair of scopes located on its center, which assisted the user in aiming the missile launcher. When fired, the rocket rifle launched a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] from its front barrel in an [[orange]] blast of light while simultaneously releasing an orange backfire from its rear barrel.<ref name="X-wing" />

==History==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], Imperial forces under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]] launched a [[Raid at Coronet|raid]] on [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], to inspire fear amongst the [[City/Legends|city's]] populace. One of the [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] under Weir's command utilized an Imperial long-range rocket rifle during the raid, demolishing a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] with the weapon at the start of the battle. However, after firing the missile, the storm [[Commando/Legends|commando]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents defending the city. One of the agents, [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]], took the rocket rifle from the fallen commando and used it against the advancing Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], destroying one of the Empire's All Terrain Scout [[Transport/Legends|Transports]] in the process. After Weir ordered his surviving [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] to pull back, Numb, with the rocket rifle strapped to his back, pursued the fleeing Imperial forces on a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]].<ref name="X-wing" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial long-range rocket rifle's first and only appearance was in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 2|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 2]], written by [[W. Haden Blackman|Haden Blackman]], illustrated by [[Tomás Giorello]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[2005]].<ref name="X-wing" />
